text: Boundary correction: the previous external blocker should not be read as absence of real data in the wider workspace. Hodgeflow supplies real source-tree NIfTI assets and an established test harness; reframe4s now consumes that court read-only through a JVM test dependency. The available pair is sub-1002 to MNI152Lin on different native grids and is only an executable bridge diagnostic. The external manifest remains doNotRun=true because same-affine ANTs provenance, an approved sub18 case, labels/surfaces, and five labeled pairs are still not admitted.
